answer:
The feature is **iterative index scans**, available starting with pgvector 0.8.0. "With approximate indexes, queries with filtering can return less results since filtering is applied *after* the index is scanned. Starting with 0.8.0, you can enable iterative index scans, which will automatically scan more of the index until enough results are found (or it reaches `hnsw.max_scan_tuples` or `ivfflat.max_probes`)." [pgvector/README.md]

You enable it with a session setting. For strict distance ordering: "SET hnsw.iterative_scan = strict_order;" [pgvector/README.md]

Relaxed ordering gives better recall at the cost of slightly out-of-order results: "SET hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order;" with the IVFFlat equivalent "SET ivfflat.iterative_scan = relaxed_order;" [pgvector/README.md]
